channel.title: Comments for page "Lessons for Old Dogs"
channel.description: Posts in the discussion thread "Lessons for Old Dogs"

item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded:
I'm pleased you liked this, Kakroom. I'll admit that I haven't provided much in the way of explanatory backlinks here - perhaps I'm wrong in assuming that people will go back and read the previous tales (although I'd encourage everyone to do so!), but I'm pleased that you were able to pick things up regardless.

The opening is a bit of a cheat, I admit - I wanted to open with action in media res, to goose the pacing a little, but without too many consequences just yet.

item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded: Great. Breaking into this from an outsider's perspective, I have no idea who any of these people are, but they all apear to have developed, distinct personalities, so I'm fine with it. It starts out really strong with all the catyclysmic imagery, and while what follows doesn't really live up to that high - ultimately making it feel like the climax came at the beginning - the training scene's great and the rest of the dialogue acts as an intriguing introduction to the rest of the universe. Can't wait to jump into the rest of the mythology and see whst comes next.

item.title: (no title)
item.content:encoded: Couldn't think of a better way to write an intro and a cliffhanger at same time. No qualms with this. +1

item.title: On Mount Golgotha - Second Suite
item.content:encoded:
We're back in earnest now. After Counterpoint, Junior Researcher Emma Stark has become Commander Emma Stark of Mobile Task Force Eta-11 ("Savage Beasts"). She needs to hunt down the missing SCP-012 (amongst other things) - but where to start the investigation?

If you haven't read the On Mount Golgotha canon before, now is the time to pick it up. This is the first tale of the Second Suite, and the action is only going to get bigger from here. If you want to start at the beginning, use the hub, or go to the first tale in the series: The Journal of K.M. Sandoval.

Many thanks are due to:

  • Leveritas, LongWalkHome, Zachary Maxwell and WrongJohnSilver - for great feedback in the forums.
  • Scorpion451 - whose artwork introduced me to the marvellous SCP-333 by Adam Smascher (and thanks to Adam too for a terrific skip).
  • Faminepulse / Crayne / SoullessSingularity - for Agent Sherry Wilson (aka Sci Fi Apple Pie) from MTF Omicron-Rho ("Dream Team"), who gets a cameo here.
  • Metaphysician - for allowing me to give Calixto Narváez a cameo as well, and helping me with his appearance.
